configuration-fields.planInputsUseClaude: Plan inputs use Claude's native plan mode. These choices control tool approvals; they do not establish filesystem sandbox isolation.

configuration-fields.claudeDeniesOperati: Claude denies operations that would require a permission prompt.

configuration-fields.savingSettingsDoesN: Saving settings does not enable Claude execution; its public execution integration is still unavailable.

configuration-fields.fullAccessPermitsNa: Full access permits native operations beyond the workspace when supported. Review this scope before using the Agent Worker.
configuration-fields.aClaudePermissionSe: A Claude permission selection is retained: <s0/>. It cannot be applied to this harness.

configuration-fields.weightsAreRelativeV: Weights are relative values from 1 to 1,000.
configuration-fields.instructionsAreAppe: Instructions are appended in this order.
configuration-fields.subscriptionProvide: Subscription providers use native-subscription protocol, subscription authentication and an empty endpoint. Login is not available.

configuration-fields.appendedToTheSelect: Appended to the selected harness's base instructions; the base instructions are preserved.

configuration-fields.anEmptySelectionPer: An empty selection permits none. Turning this restriction off permits every otherwise eligible entry.

configuration-fields.theHarnessStartsInT: The harness starts in this repository. Select it explicitly after adding repositories.
configuration-fields.aMissingOrDeletedPr: A missing or deleted profile requires reconfiguration. GitHub lookup never chooses another token or changes this Worker's Git authentication.
configuration-fields.inspectionReadsTheS: Inspection reads the selected Worker's Git checkout without fetching. Saving revalidates every checkout on its owning Worker before publishing the configuration.

configuration-fields.inspectionWasAcknow: Inspection was acknowledged without a readable job. Inspect the original request before submitting another.
configuration-fields.useChangeFolderToRe: Use Change folder to replace this checkout.
configuration-fields.baseControlsCompari: Base controls comparisons; starting controls prepared code. A missing or ambiguous default is reported by the Worker. Local sessions keep their existing checkout unchanged.
configuration-fields.fetchTheExactSelect: Fetch the exact selected remote before Worktree preparation
configuration-fields.thisRepositoryInher: This repository inherits the complete server remediation policy, including future changes.
configuration-fields.setRepositoryPolicy: Set repository policy with automation off
configuration-fields.thisCompleteReposit: This complete repository policy replaces the server policy. Empty reviewer or execution selections remain empty.
configuration-fields.configuredCompatibi: Configured compatibility is checked against the installed harness before execution. It does not prove execution support.
configuration-fields.legacySubscriptionC: Legacy subscription configuration was retired. Choose the current model and accounts explicitly. Project restrictions that became empty continue to deny all accounts.
